commit_message: Fix ADR 0131 AI Studio launcher layering
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0131 conversational AI Studio foundation
pr_body:
## Summary

- implement the ADR 0131 conversational AI Studio foundation on the current main baseline
- add the GUI-free agent host, resumable project-scoped state, permission boundaries, isolated code workspace, and thin Editor AI Studio frontend
- preserve the validated foundation behavior and the Editor Clippy cleanup
- keep the toolbar launcher below modeless Editor windows so AI Studio content is not obscured when window bounds overlap the toolbar region

## Validation

- Windows affected validation for engine-editor
- Editor visual validation with screenshot inspection
